name: Worg
notes: CR 1/2. Large. Bite +5 (2d6+3 piercing). DC 13 STR save or knocked prone. Keen Hearing and Smell.
gm_notes: Session 2 raid, Phase 2. Two Worgs with riders that got around the east wall during Phase 1. Arrive through the postern or over a lower section. Used as heavy cavalry inside the courtyard. Keen Hearing and Smell: advantage on Perception using hearing or smell. Bite knocks prone on failed DC 13 STR save. Frightening in confined spaces — harder to avoid than wolves, and Large size blocks corridors.
